comment: G3 Phase 4 starter hulls - REAL public-domain spacecraft only (owner decision 4). Every model is from NASA's own 3D Resources collection (github.com/nasa/NASA-3D-Resources); NASA media policy places models, textures and polygon data in the public domain in the US. The NASA insignia is separately protected - none of these trade on it. Textured models were resampled to 512 px at build; all arrive Draco-compressed and the app's loader decodes them. lengthM is the craft's real longest dimension, offered as a dimensions hint only - the authored dimensionsM always wins.
